name: Saint Martin
prevalence_note: The prefecture for Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin has published a digital-fraud warning, and national French guidance documents fake parcel and bank SMS asking for card data and codes.
cross_border_note: French Saint-Martin (+590) shares the island with Sint Maarten (+1-721), so residents get calls from both sides plus mainland France (+33).

scams.name: Faux SMS bancaire ou colis demandant un code
scams.name_en: Fake bank or parcel SMS in Saint-Martin asking for a card or one-time code
scams.signals_en: A text posing as a bank or courier claims a blocked payment or parcel and pushes the owner to give card numbers or a one-time code.
scams.legit_en: The prefecture and French cyber-assistance advise never sharing a bank code; banks do not request it by SMS or phone.
bait_tactics: Demander quelle agence de Marigot gère le compte
Dire que le téléphone avec l'application bancaire est resté au bureau
